description:
FILES: extensions/custom_footer.ex, test/octo_pi/coder/extensions/custom_footer_test.exs

REQUIRES: opi-fin.2.2, opi-fin.2.3

Same migration pattern as opi-fin.5.1 (StatusLine). Read custom_footer.ex to identify the state shape, handler names, and Agent usage. Apply the same 4-step transformation: use macro, remove init/2, add mount/0, convert handlers to public 3-arity callbacks with state threading.

DO NOT change any ctx.ui fn-field calls -- Phase 7 handles those.
DO NOT change any bind_core usage if present -- Phase 6 handles that.

TEST: Remove outer Agent setup from custom_footer_test.exs. Use &CustomFooter.init/1 as factory.
title: Migrate CustomFooter to mount/0 pattern
